description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Order made to vest with the Urban Development Authority the land called 'Slaughter House for Sheep' situated at Dematagoda belonging to the Colombo Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the vesting of a land parcel (the "Slaughter House for Sheep" property) from the Colombo Municipal Council to the Urban Development Authority. It includes detailed land description, boundaries, survey plan references, and location details, making it clearly a Land Gazette under Type 4 classification. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content is about land transfer/property matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
